question: Does an explicit learned strategic repertoire deserve to exist, before any latent-conditioned policy is trained?
why_this_gate_exists: V3 validation established that the environment ADMITS a valuable two-mode solution. It did NOT establish that learning discovers or needs one. PPO could still converge on a single adequate compromise policy. That is a separate failure mode, answered by training rather than by the scripted confirmation.

R1_train_three_policies.compute_fairness: the generalist receives 2T steps because the repertoire consumes 2T total (T + T). This forecloses the obvious objection that the repertoire won by spending twice the environment interaction.
R1_train_three_policies.T: TO BE SET before launch and frozen; identical for both specialists

training_seeds.note: disjoint blocks, audited; PopulationTrainer per-member offsets up to 300 are covered by 320-wide reservations

R1_train_three_policies.mandatory_precondition: assert on the LIVE core object that pole A's overlay (min_alive_for_defender=2) is applied before any training step is consumed. Training against plain OP6 by accident would invalidate the entire ladder.

R2_learned_payoff_matrix.matrix: rows {pi_G, pi_A, pi_B} x columns {A, B}

gate_learned_crossover.requires: V(pi_A, A) > V(pi_B, A)  AND  V(pi_B, B) > V(pi_A, B)
gate_learned_crossover.meaning: the learning analogue of the scripted reversal already validated
gate_learned_crossover.if_fails: STOP. The environment contains the strategies but PPO is not discovering complementary ones. That is a legitimate, publishable result and directs work to LEARNING, not latent compression.

R3_oracle_repertoire_value.threshold_provenance: reused from the campaign's earlier repertoire-value standard (delta_pool floor 0.05), NOT invented after seeing results
R3_oracle_repertoire_value.explicitly_not_deployment_valid: the oracle secretly knows which opponent it faces. Because A and B are deliberately concealed, oracle routing CHEATS. This establishes repertoire EXISTENCE only and is reported as an upper-bound diagnostic.
R3_oracle_repertoire_value.if_fails: STOP. No repertoire value even with perfect routing.

R4_opponent_blind_mixture_THE_REAL_TEST.why_this_is_primary: because A and B are concealed before commitment, a legitimate repertoire cannot know which specialist to deploy. This asks whether an explicit population provides value under the SAME uncertainty the generalist faces.
R4_opponent_blind_mixture_THE_REAL_TEST.procedure: sample the policy ONCE before the episode from a fixed mixture P(pi_A)=p, P(pi_B)=1-p, with NO access to opponent identity, then commit for the whole episode
R4_opponent_blind_mixture_THE_REAL_TEST.p_selection: chosen from a SEPARATE development payoff matrix on block 7600001..7600192, then FROZEN before touching the evaluation block
R4_opponent_blind_mixture_THE_REAL_TEST.if_passes: multiple learned strategic policies are USEFUL without cheating on opponent identity. This is what licenses latent work.
R4_opponent_blind_mixture_THE_REAL_TEST.if_fails: the repertoire exists but is not deployably valuable. Latent compression would be compressing something that does not pay.
R4_opponent_blind_mixture_THE_REAL_TEST.structural_note: this mirrors what a latent policy must ultimately do: sample z at episode start, commit, opponent identity stays hidden

R5_memory_control_before_claiming_latent.requirement: compare a recurrent / event-conditioned PPO against the explicit repertoire
R5_memory_control_before_claiming_latent.distinguishes: 'memory solves it' from 'persistent strategic modes provide additional value'
R5_memory_control_before_claiming_latent.status: required for publication-quality claims that LATENT specifically is necessary; not a blocker for running the latent experiment itself

latent_gate.unlocked_only_if: R2 crossover AND R3 oracle value AND R4 opponent-blind mixture value all pass
latent_gate.then: train pi(a|o,z), z in {0,1}, z sampled ONCE at episode start and held FIXED for the episode
latent_gate.why_fixed_z: matches the persistent-strategy hypothesis and prevents z from degenerating into an instantaneous tactical router, which is what the earlier failed attempts produced
latent_gate.reframed_question: not 'please become different somehow' but 'compress two already-proven-useful strategic responses into one shared network'
measurements: does the latent mixture match the explicit population
how much is lost by compressing two policies into one shared network

stop_rules: R2 crossover fails -> STOP, learning problem, not a latent problem
R3 oracle value fails -> STOP, no repertoire value even with perfect routing
R4 mixture fails -> repertoire exists but is not deployably valuable; do NOT proceed to latent
no threshold may be moved after seeing any result
no extension of any evaluation block
prohibited: training a latent-conditioned policy before R2, R3 and R4 all pass
using opponent identity as a policy input anywhere except the explicitly-labelled R3 oracle diagnostic
changing the benchmark environment in any way
giving the repertoire more total environment interaction than the generalist
